summary: ACCEPT. Installs the CW-v2 armed-segment pager schedule into root's crontab. THIS CLOSES A P1 I RAISED AND IT IS THE POINT OF THE PR: armed_segments_check.py had NO INVOCATION PATH AT ALL. Verified with the denominator stated -- no systemd timer, no unit file, no crontab entry for any user in /etc/passwd, nothing in /etc/cron.d or cron.daily/hourly, no workflow. Eleven review rounds hardened a script that nothing called, and the v2 source comment claiming 'armed_segments_check will page' was false the whole time. REBASE VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY: base is the current main tip, is an ancestor of the head, and I recomputed git patch-id --stable myself getting 38dbc6c1b3147c8b1989dddad0143b593cd11099, matching the report. Three files, 1 of 1 agent markers. SCHEDULE: */5 10-21 * * 1-5. I asked for 10-21 rather than the submitted 11-21 and codex agreed. 11 UTC is 07:00 ET, which is EXACTLY when the entry window opens, so a pager starting there reports suppression concurrently with it and gives zero actionable lead. 10 UTC is 06:00 ET and buys a full hour. ⭐ I ALSO REVERSED MY OWN EARLIER INSTRUCTION here, recorded because it was wrong: I told codex not to install before Monday's watch, reasoning it would page all weekend on the expected held condition. The schedule is 1-5, weekdays only, so it CANNOT fire on a weekend. Installing BEFORE Monday is the safer choice -- v2 will be roughly 61h past boot, far outside the 600s BOOT_HOLD_GRACE_SECS, so an unreleased hold PAGES instead of failing silent. VERIFIED BY EXECUTED MUTATION, RUN NATIVELY ON LINUX. Baseline 3 passed. M1, schedule drifted back to 11-21: 1 failed, 2 passed, killed by test_installer_reads_back_exactly_one_managed_schedule_and_preserves_preimage -- so the hours I requested are PINNED and cannot silently regress, which was my specific worry. M2, the verify_exactly_one_managed_entry call neutered: 3 failed, killed by the readback-rollback and duplicate-refusal tests. Restore hash-verified byte-identical at 00967986676b19227ba0f39b7ff89c7d109a8d3fa18096a3536c0d774afd4a87; the throwaway clone was removed. ⛔ HONESTY ABOUT MY FIRST ATTEMPT, recorded because the failure mode recurs on this operator's Windows machine: running these tests locally produced 1 failed, 2 passed and I nearly reported codex's '3 passed' as contradicted. The failure was a Git Bash PATH-FORM artifact -- the installer wrote the block correctly, BEGIN/END markers and all, but _shell_path() produced a /c/... form that did not match the installed line. A LINUX-TARGETED SHELL INSTALLER CANNOT BE GRADED ON WINDOWS: that run was VOID, not negative, and the native run is the evidence. INSTALLER DISCIPLINE CONFIRMED, transferred from #828: pre-image backups into a 0700 root-owned dir, an EXIT rollback trap, grep -Fxc WHOLE-LINE matching so a commented-out schedule cannot count as present, verify_exactly_one_managed_entry, and BEGIN/END marker block-shape checks. NOT MEASURED: only the focused test file was run for these mutants; no full-suite check, and no mutant probed the backup-directory-creation refusal paths. ⛔ DEPLOY NOTE: ops/** is NOT sync-only eligible and needs an explicit copy plus running the installer. It requires no service restart -- restart_required=0 is printed by the installer itself.
